hypotheses.name: trend_pullback_breakout
hypotheses.hypothesis: Daily uptrend plus intraday pullback-and-breakout may produce positive net returns after costs
hypotheses.comparator: No-trade baseline and report net trade return; no claim versus buy-and-hold on non-equivalent exposure

hypotheses.name: M0_plus_ema21
hypotheses.hypothesis: Adding an intraday 21 EMA support/reclaim filter improves out-of-sample or risk-adjusted performance versus M0

hypotheses.name: M1_plus_causal_avwap
hypotheses.hypothesis: A causal rolling-high anchored VWAP reclaim filter adds incremental value over the EMA-filtered model

interpretation: Exploratory hypothesis screen only. Small recent samples cannot establish alpha, inference, parameter stability, or Paper eligibility.
discipline: Lock primary parameters before seeing prototype outcomes
Do not optimize on the first sample
Treat zero or few trades as insufficient evidence
